introduction: A modern provisions brand connecting carefully grown ingredients with the familiar pleasure of a well-stocked kitchen.

challenge.heading: Farm-led quality that felt too far away.
challenge.copy: Fieldwork had strong supplier relationships and genuinely good products, but its presentation leaned worthy rather than useful. The brand needed to make provenance feel immediate, appetising, and part of everyday cooking.

contribution.heading: A practical brand with dirt under its nails.
contribution.copy: We clarified the promise, built an identity from field marks and confident type, and designed a packaging system that makes ingredients easy to navigate while keeping the growers and their work close to the story.
